scenarios.name: Hero Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify the hero section displays product name, tagline, and call-to-action buttons correctly (REQ-1)

steps.description: Navigate to the MirDB homepage URL
steps.context: User lands on the homepage for the first time

steps.description: Check that product name 'MirDB' is prominently displayed along with tagline
steps.context: Hero section should be the first visible section

steps.description: Check that 'Get Started' and 'View on GitHub' buttons are present and styled correctly
steps.context: CTA buttons should be clearly visible and clickable

test_cases.input: Load homepage and inspect hero section HTML structure
test_cases.expected: h1 element contains 'MirDB' product name

test_cases.input: Check hero section for tagline element
test_cases.expected: Tagline 'Persistent Key-Value Store with Memcached Protocol' or similar is displayed
'Get Started' button exists with appropriate styling and href
'View on GitHub' button exists with link to GitHub repository
Opens GitHub repository in new tab with rel='noopener'

scenarios.name: Value Propositions Section
scenarios.description: Verify the three core value propositions are displayed in a three-column layout (REQ-2)

steps.description: Scroll or navigate to the section displaying MirDB's core value propositions
steps.context: Section should be below the hero section

steps.description: Check that all three value propositions are present: Memcached compatibility, persistence, LSM tree architecture
steps.context: Should be displayed in a three-column layout on desktop

steps.description: Each proposition should have a title and supporting description
steps.context: Content should accurately represent MirDB capabilities

test_cases.input: Query DOM for value proposition section
test_cases.expected: Section exists with three distinct proposition items
Contains content about 'Memcached Protocol Compatibility' or 'Drop-in Memcached Compatibility'
Contains content about 'Data Persistence' or 'Built-in Persistence' with SSTables
Contains content about 'LSM Tree Architecture'

test_cases.input: Verify three-column layout on desktop viewport
test_cases.expected: Value propositions render side-by-side in three columns at desktop width (>=1024px)

scenarios.name: Getting Started Section

steps.description: Scroll or navigate to the Getting Started section of the page

steps.context: Should include actual command to install/run MirDB

steps.description: Check that basic usage example is provided

test_cases.input: Check for Getting Started section existence
test_cases.expected: Section with heading 'Getting Started' or similar exists
Code block or pre element contains installation command
Code snippet showing basic client connection or command usage is present
Configuration example with TOML or similar format is displayed

test_cases.input: Measure time to locate Getting Started from page load
test_cases.expected: Getting Started section is findable within 30 seconds (success metric)
